part.text: Fixed. The `PostOrderIterator.next()` in `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/Node.java` now returns the root (and sets `hasNext = false`) when the stack is empty, i.e. when the root has no children — instead of throwing `EmptyStackException` from `peek()`. All 2335 tests in `javaparser-core-testing` pass, including the new `rootHasNoChild` case.
